entries.1784c52d6532cbda: The company's core store format. Under the slogan “delicious and low-priced”, it serves items such as “Chuka Soba” at ¥420 per 1 bowl and “Vegetable-Packed Tanmen”. entries.9d4b755a56830bc0: A company that directly operates Chinese-style restaurants in the Kanto region, centered on "Hidakaya," where 1 bowl of Chinese noodles costs ¥420.
entries.b9f67f50f99ee854: This is a directly operated chain of Chinese-style restaurants. As of the end of February 2026, the company directly operated 472 stores across the Kanto region's 1 metropolitan area and 6 prefectures, including 210 in Tokyo, 109 in Saitama, 73 in Kanagawa, and 59 in Chiba. To improve and stabilize quality and achieve uniformity, the functions from food procurement, manufacturing of noodles, gyoza and seasonings, operational management of orders for each store, to logistics are concentrated at the Gyoda Plant in Gyoda, Saitama Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥62,252 million.
